title: Four in court after baby stabbed to death in Sheffield
summary_full: The two men and two women accused of murder as well as causing or allowing death of a child and perverting course of justiceFour people have appeared in court charged with murder after a newborn baby girl was stabbed to death in Sheffield.Two men and two women were remanded in custody on Wednesday following the death of the newborn named only as Baby S.
